package: @astryxdesign/lab

# CommentThreadInPopover - Open one thread from a passage in a Popover with no padding. The thread owns the Popover's dismissal through `onDismiss`, so turn the Popover's light and Escape dismissal off: a press outside or Escape closes the thread, but the first one over an unsaved reply shakes it and keeps the draft.
# Components: Card, CommentThread, Popover

<Card padding={4} width={420}>
  <VStack gap={3}>
    <Text />
    <Popover padding={0} width={340} />
    /* content: */
    <CommentThread />
    <Button variant="secondary" />
  </VStack>
</Card>
